name: lnpl-mcp
description: Expose the LNPL compiler to the model as MCP tools instead of a shell command. `lnpl compile` writes its diagnostics to stderr and exits 0, so a caller that branches on the exit code misses every warning — and an unknown verb is a warning that means the step does nothing at runtime. These tools return the diagnostic records as structured data, call the already-imported compiler directly (no PATH lookup, no stream redirection), and route a design decision to the knowledge base before it is made.
